paragraphs.text: According as all men die, for as much as they are sinners.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: That is, their matter to be judged, to know what he should determine, as he did all hard matters.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Meaning, an ordinance to judge by.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Who as he has created, so he governs the hearts of all men.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: That is, govern them and do his duty, as in 2Ch 1:10.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Commend him to the people as suitable for the office and appointed by God.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: According to his office: signifying that the civil magistrate could execute nothing but that which he knew to be the will of God.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: How he should govern himself in his office.
